title: Accept loop dies silently on error
description: In main.rs, the tailnet accept loop breaks on any accept() error (line 116-118). The task exits with a single tracing::error\! but no re-spawn, no process exit, no further log. The daemon appears healthy (process running, outbox ticking) but accepts no new connections on that IP. An operator monitoring the process would not notice. Fix: either re-spawn the accept task on break, or call std::process::exit(1), or at minimum emit a tracing::error\! that is clearly fatal ('accept loop terminated, listener dead').
